findings: Correct STEP V-parameter evaluation removes the mirrored-axis defect and materially improves target placement.
Two-surface normal verification removes some point-proximity false positives, especially on 40500000 and compound 38172000 regions.
Simple tray and bracket bends are frequently well localized and visually interpretable.
Inner lips, rolled features, beads, and compound rounded regions still create multiple physically real CAD axes for one inspection-level bend identity.
One scan correctly abstains because no trusted automatic overlay is available.
The overlays are suitable as ranked operator suggestions but not as autonomous production pass/fail evidence.
